title: Retention
description: How long meeting records, transcripts and recordings are kept. Each of the two periods in days defaults to the value the stack was deployed with, which is also the longest this deployment allows: a shorter period can be set here, a longer one cannot. How long recordings are kept in the recordings bucket otherwise follows the AudioRecordingExpirationInDays stack parameter and the bucket's lifecycle rules; the recordings can also be deleted after the summary, below.
appliesText: A saved period in days applies within about five minutes, to records written after that; a saved transcript or recording deletion choice applies to the next meeting that ends. A record already written keeps the expiry it was given, and a meeting already scheduled for deletion keeps its time.

meetingRecordExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep meeting records
meetingRecordExpirationInDays.description: How long a meeting, its summary and its usage records are kept after each is written; fractions of a day are allowed. At most the MeetingRecordExpirationInDays stack parameter, which is also the default.

transcriptionExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep transcript segments
transcriptionExpirationInDays.description: How long each turn of a meeting's transcript, and each meeting assistant answer in it, is kept after it is written; fractions of a day are allowed. At most the TranscriptionExpirationInDays stack parameter, which is also the default.

transcriptDeletionAfterSummary.title: Delete the transcript after the summary
transcriptDeletionAfterSummary.description: Off: the transcript is kept for the days set above. Otherwise the meeting's transcript is deleted permanently once its summary is written, immediately or after the delay chosen here: every turn of the transcript and every meeting assistant answer, the transcript file in the recordings bucket (all of its versions), and its entry in the transcript knowledge base. The summary, the meeting record, the recording and the consent record are kept. If no summary has been written 60 minutes after the meeting ends, the delay counts from then; on a deployment with no end-of-meeting summary, it counts from the end of the meeting. See docs/transcript-deletion.md.

enumLabels.off: Off (keep for the days set above)

recordingDeletionAfterSummary.title: Delete the recordings after the summary
recordingDeletionAfterSummary.description: Off: the recordings are kept as the AudioRecordingExpirationInDays stack parameter says. Otherwise the meeting's audio and video recordings are deleted permanently once its summary is written, immediately or after the delay chosen here: every recording file of every capture session in the recordings bucket, all of its versions, and the meeting no longer offers them for playback or download. A recording stored after the deletion is deleted when it arrives. The summary, the shared-screen key frames and their text, the chat attachments, the consent record and its evidence are kept, and the transcript follows the setting above. If no summary has been written 60 minutes after the meeting ends, the delay counts from then; on a deployment with no end-of-meeting summary, it counts from the end of the meeting. See docs/transcript-deletion.md.

enumLabels.off: Off (keep as the stack parameters say)
